description:
I’ll give you the short version and the long version

The long version has the step by step to transform your life,

But here’s the short one:

If you can learn to be where you are, 

by freeing yourself from constant stress about the future...

...you will never procrastinate again.

Step 3: Enjoy the process.

We’re working out of order. Step 3, Step 1, then Step 2.

When is it that you’re happiest?

You’re happiest when you’re enjoying something.

Enjoy what I’m doing? Sam—how? I hate it. 

That’s why I’m procrastinating. How can I enjoy what I hate?

That’s what step 1 is for. 

Step 1: Let go of perfect.

If you want something to be the magical solution that completely solves the problem...

...you will never solve the problem.

but it’s so much easier than that:

Let go of perfect. 

STOP trying to do something you don’t know how to do—

—you can’t do shit you don’t know how to do.

So stop trying to be perfect. You don’t know how yet. 

YET.

Step 2:

Get a little more information.

A solution isn’t one and done, so...

...assume that you DON’T have the solution,

and just look for a little more information:

i.e. “I don’t know how to solve this—

—what would help me figure it out?”

You’ll be amazed by the answers you’ll reach.

And when you HAVE a little more information, 

you’ll also know where to look for a little more.

Rinse, repeat.

Step 3: Enjoy the process.

When you’re in the problem solving and you’re enjoying the problem solving... 

...you’ve reached the destination.

YOU’VE REACHED THE DESTINATION.

There isn’t anywhere else to go.

Why would you want to be anywhere OTHER than enjoyment?

And importantly—

—would you procrastinate something you’re enjoying?

If you can learn to be where you are...

...instead of in constant stress...

...you will never procrastinate again.

So let me ask:

Are you ready to stop procrastinating? 

Are you working in a job that makes you wonder where your life is going? 

Do you want YOUR life, instead of the one your bills decided for you?

Comment ‘NOW’, and I’ll help you stay on the path.

Let’s change this shit forever.
